# Instrument Serif

`src/assets/fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-normal.woff2` is Instrument Serif
Regular, Latin subset, as packaged by Fontsource
(`@fontsource/instrument-serif`, `files/instrument-serif-latin-400-normal.woff2`)
from https://github.com/Instrument/instrument-serif.

SHA-256: 5eb09b5ac0e28b67c2f041c8ba6d244604ca0c0980d65912ab2d47fed84ddc31

Used for the headlines of the in-app What's new page
(`src/components/WhatsNewDialog.tsx`, `@font-face` in `src/styles.css`).
Bundled rather than loaded from Google Fonts at runtime, because the desktop
app has to work offline.
